title: When Do “More Contexts” Help with Sarcasm Recognition?

bias_targets.methodology: Manual qualitative analysis of test-set samples to observe if the model relies on negativity or pre-existing sentiment toward specific political figures or groups (e.g., Obama, Hillary, pro-lifers) to correctly classify sarcasm.

Manual qualitative analysis of model predictions to identify if the model depends on biases against specific ideologies or concepts (e.g., Intelligent Design, conspiracy theories) to detect a sarcastic tone.

Manual evaluation of text samples to detect if the model uses encoded negative sentiment associated with specific public figures or individuals (e.g., Chris Brown, reality TV contestants) to identify sarcasm.
